## Purpose
`/admin/logs/$workspaceId/$traceId`: one activity trace, viewed by an admin.

## Responsibilities
- `ActivityTracePage` reads `adminApi.activityTrace(workspaceId, traceId)` and renders it with `observability/TraceDetailPage`.
- `WhoAndWhere` shows the actor and the workspace.
- Titled "Activity — Admin console".

## Key elements
`ActivityTracePage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/admin/logs/{ws}/traces/{trace}`.
